why: X names its subject clearly with large, high-contrast text. Y has a pretty but unrelated image, and its caption and source line sit on a washed-out background.
top_fix_for_weaker: Put the caption on a solid or much darker bottom scrim at a larger size, and add a place and date label (e.g. 'Detroit, c.1900s'). Shorten the source line and enlarge it. Pick an image that actually illustrates the claim, or caption what the image shows.
